cases.name: det-uuid-basic
cases.description: single UUID -> one high finding with exact code-point span

cases.description: ISO datetime variants; contained date-iso/clock-time removed by strictly-longer containment dedupe (fix f: no trailing-space span)

cases.name: det-epoch-negative
cases.description: 10 digits with 15-prefix and an 11-digit number do not match

cases.name: det-secret-like
cases.description: api_key and secret assignments flagged (security + cache)

cases.description: all six template families fire: braces, jinja, dollar, percent-named, angle, bracket

input.text: Hello {user_name}, {{ customer.id }} and ${ORDER_ID} and %(name)s and <USER_NAME> and [INSERT COMPANY]

cases.name: det-json-not-flagged
cases.description: JSON literals and non-identifier braces are not template slots

cases.name: det-template-angle-negative
cases.description: lowercase tags and too-short uppercase tags do not match

cases.name: det-percent-bare-lookbehind
cases.description: %s after whitespace fires; digit/word/percent prefixes are blocked

input.text: use %s here but 100%s and x%d and 50%% stay

cases.name: det-clock-time-no-trailing-space
cases.description: fix f: bare time span has no trailing space; am/pm and seconds variants keep exact spans

input.text: Meet at 12:30 tomorrow; dinner at 7:45 PM; job ran 19:05:33 fine

cases.name: det-date-family
cases.description: date-iso, date-us, date-verbose (dotted + plain), date-phrase

input.text: Due 2026-07-30, or 12/31/2026, or January 5, 2026, or Sept. 3 2026 because today's date matters

cases.name: det-hex-id-mixed
cases.description: hex-id needs digits AND letters (validate); pure digits / pure letters stay silent

input.text: hash 0123456789abcdef0123 ok; digits 1234567890123456 no; word deadbeefdeadbeef no

cases.name: det-overlap-both-kept
cases.description: partially overlapping equal-length matches from two detectors are BOTH kept, sorted by (start, -length)

cases.name: det-containment-strictly-longer
cases.description: datetime strictly contains date-iso and clock-time -> only the container survives

cases.name: det-unicode-hebrew-boundary
cases.description: fix d/e: Hebrew letter adjacent to a date suppresses the word boundary; spaced date still matches at code-point offsets

cases.name: det-unicode-emoji-offsets
cases.description: astral emoji before a UUID: start/end/excerpt are code-point based

cases.name: det-excerpt-edges
cases.description: no leading ... at text start, no trailing ... at text end, newline in excerpt becomes the two-char literal backslash-n

cases.name: det-pct-rounding-half-even
cases.description: 400-cp text, uuid at cp 49 -> pct_into_prompt 12.25 rounds half-even to 12.2

cases.name: det-empty
cases.description: empty text -> no findings

cases.name: det-clean-prose
cases.description: benign prose -> no findings

input.text: Please summarize the quarterly logistics report in three bullet points.

cases.name: det-severity-gating
cases.description: low-only findings (clock time, bare %d) -> first_blocking_index is null

input.text: The meeting is at 15:30 in room 4, use %d formatting.
